_doc: Medical catalog keys (R2 3.3 and 3.11): questionnaires and crisis contacts, disclaimers of the app, the export and the assistant, and texts about thresholds, red flags and the evidence behind a reading. A value of these keys in any language other than German is written by scripts/xcstrings-add.py with state `needs_review`; a person approves it by setting `translated` and names themselves and the date in the unit report. scripts/l10n/check-catalog-format.py reports open reviews in CI and, with --release (freeze pregates), fails while one sits in a `required` language. Every prefix and key here must match at least one key of a shipped catalog (`report.` keys live in HealthLog/Resources/DoctorReport.xcstrings, the doctor report's own table), so the list cannot rot.
